question: The simplified value of the expression [(18 + 6) div 3 times 2 - 4] times [5 + 3²] - 2 times (8 - 3) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve brackets first: (18 + 6) = 24 and (8 − 3) = 5

Expression becomes: [24 ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 9] − 2 × 5

= [8 × 2 − 4] × 14 − 10

= [16 − 4] × 14 − 10 = 12 × 14 − 10

**∴ Answer = 158**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

[(18 + 6) ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 3²] − 2 × (8 − 3)

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ [(18 + 6) ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 3²] − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [24 ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 3²] − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [24 ÷ 3 × 2 − 4] × [5 + 9] − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [8 × 2 − 4] × 14 − 2 × (8 − 3)

⇒ [16 − 4] × 14 − 2 × 5

⇒ 12 × 14 − 2 × 5

⇒ 168 − 2 × 5

⇒ 168 − 10

⇒ 158

**∴ The correct answer is 158.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Full Form

Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction

Order of Operations

Solve brackets first, then powers, then ÷ and ×, then + and −

Left to Right Rule

For × and ÷, solve from left to right

Simplification Tip

Always simplify step-by-step without skipping operations
